sources.title: Receive a delivery
sources.text: Keep the receiving lane clear. Count every carton before signing. Compare the count with the delivery note. If a carton is damaged, stop receiving that carton and tell the supervisor.
mandatory_facts: Keep the receiving lane clear.
Count every carton before signing.
Compare the count with the delivery note.
mandatory_warnings: If a carton is damaged, stop receiving that carton and tell the supervisor.

sources.title: Pack a kit
sources.text: Check the kit label first. Put two pads in each box. Close the box after checking its contents. Do not use a torn box; replace it before packing.
mandatory_facts: Check the kit label first.
Put two pads in each box.
Close the box after checking its contents.
mandatory_warnings: Do not use a torn box; replace it before packing.

sources.title: Label a carton
sources.text: Read the part ID on the pick list. Match the ID to the carton contents. Attach one label to the flat side. If the IDs differ, stop and ask the supervisor.
mandatory_facts: Read the part ID on the pick list.
Match the ID to the carton contents.
Attach one label to the flat side.
mandatory_warnings: If the IDs differ, stop and ask the supervisor.

sources.title: Handle a shortage
sources.text: Record the part ID and the number of missing units. Set the incomplete kit aside. Tell the supervisor before continuing. Do not substitute another part.
mandatory_facts: Record the part ID and the number of missing units.
Set the incomplete kit aside.
Tell the supervisor before continuing.

sources.title: Recount stock
sources.text: Count the units in the marked bin. Record the count without changing the stock record. Ask a second worker to repeat the count. If the counts disagree, stop and tell the supervisor.
mandatory_facts: Count the units in the marked bin.
Record the count without changing the stock record.
Ask a second worker to repeat the count.
mandatory_warnings: If the counts disagree, stop and tell the supervisor.

sources.title: Receive a return
sources.text: Place the returned box in the returns area. Read the return ID. Record the ID and visible damage. Do not put returned parts into available stock until the supervisor checks them.
mandatory_facts: Place the returned box in the returns area.
Read the return ID.
Record the ID and visible damage.
mandatory_warnings: Do not put returned parts into available stock until the supervisor checks them.

sources.title: Isolate damaged cartons
sources.text: Keep the damaged carton in the marked hold area. Record its delivery ID. Tell the supervisor. Do not open a leaking carton.
mandatory_facts: Keep the damaged carton in the marked hold area.
Record its delivery ID.
Tell the supervisor.
mandatory_warnings: Do not open a leaking carton.

sources.title: Dispatch a kit
sources.text: Match the completed kit ID to the dispatch list. Count the boxes. Record the box count before moving them to dispatch. Stop if any ID does not match.
mandatory_facts: Match the completed kit ID to the dispatch list.
Count the boxes.
Record the box count before moving them to dispatch.
mandatory_warnings: Stop if any ID does not match.

sources.title: Place a part on hold
sources.text: Place the part in the marked hold bin. Attach a hold label with the part ID. Ask the supervisor to review it. Do not use a held part in a kit.
mandatory_facts: Place the part in the marked hold bin.
Attach a hold label with the part ID.
Ask the supervisor to review it.
mandatory_warnings: Do not use a held part in a kit.

sources.title: Hand over unfinished work
sources.text: List unfinished kits and their IDs. Record the missing parts for each kit. Give the list to the next supervisor. Do not mark an unfinished kit complete.
mandatory_facts: List unfinished kits and their IDs.
Record the missing parts for each kit.
Give the list to the next supervisor.
mandatory_warnings: Do not mark an unfinished kit complete.

sources.title: Receive a delivery (historical)
sources.text: Count cartons at the old receiving desk. Ask the supervisor before signing.
mandatory_facts: Count cartons at the old receiving desk.
Ask the supervisor before signing.

sources.title: Conflicting sample receiving instruction
sources.text: Sign the delivery note before counting any cartons.
